result.title: Alignment Flywheel-Guided Suppression Patching for Interactionless Inverse Reinforcement Learning
result.comment: Accepted for The 38th Benelux Conference on Artificial Intelligence and the 35th Belgian Dutch Conference on Machine Learning
result.summary: Learned reward models allow reinforcement-learning agents to use demonstrations, implicit feedback, safety constraints, social norms, or other sources that do not provide a complete hand-designed scalar reward. However, a learned reward model can assign high reward to unwanted behavior. A policy can exploit these errors during training. Later requirements can also identify additional regions where the deployed reward should change. We introduce \emph{flywheel-guided patching}, a mechanism for making such localized corrections without retraining the learned evaluator. An Alignment Flywheel identifies overgeneralized or constraint-violating regions and compiles verified findings into suppression patches. We instantiate the mechanism for Interactionless Inverse Reinforcement Learning using MoE-GUIDE, placing patches in the model's latent space and retrieving only a small local subset during online reward evaluation. In the main MuJoCo benchmark, we evaluate patching without expert-state reset warm starts. We also test whether operator-specified norms absent from the demonstrations can be compiled into the same reward interface and compare this with enforcing the corresponding rules online. The results show that localized corrective information can modify an existing learned reward without providing a complete replacement reward. Compilation can reuse judgments that are expensive or unavailable during control. Cheap deterministic rules may be simpler to check directly at each step. Code for MoE-GUIDE, Alignment Flywheel, and flywheel patching is at https://github.com/decide-ugent/Alignment-Flywheel.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 flywheel-guided patching：用 Alignment Flywheel 找出奖励模型过泛化或违反约束的区域，编译为抑制补丁放入 MoE-GUIDE 的 latent space，在线奖励评估时只检索少量局部补丁，从而在不重训评测器的情况下局部修正已学奖励，并在 MuJoCo 上与在线规则执行做比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把局部修正信息编码进潜空间、按需检索小规模子集」的机制，可能为 LVR 中向 latent 推理状态注入外部证据或做局部编辑提供可核查的方法线索，但任务与多模态推理距离较远，需人工判断可迁移性。
